title: DSA, AIA, and LLMs: Approaches to conceptualizing and auditing moderation in LLM-based chatbots across languages and interfaces in the electoral contexts

bias_targets.methodology: Translating election-related prompts into ten different languages (e.g., English, German, Polish, Dutch, Romanian) and performing automated and manual prompting to compare the frequency of active moderation (refusals to answer) across the languages.

Counterfactual analysis swapping specific electoral context variables (e.g., substituting 'EU election' with 'US election') within analogous prompts to measure discrepancies in chatbot moderation rates between different regional democratic processes.
